description: This file defines the DeletedViewModel class, which manages deleted notes within the application. It inherits from AbstractNotesViewModel and provides methods to access deleted notes and to permanently delete them, also handling cleanup of associated media storage.

classes.name: DeletedViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel responsible for managing deleted notes, allowing retrieval and permanent deletion of notes in the deleted bin, and cleaning up media storage.

methods.name: permanentlyDeleteNotesInBin
methods.description: Deletes notes permanently from the bin and cleans up associated media storage.
